(Only one attribute-stacking sigil can be active at a time.)}} | type = sigil | element = Enhancement | rarity = exotic | level = 60 | value = 216 | salvage = Standard, Research | id = 24584 }} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{Contained in}} === Recipes === {{recipe | source = discovery | type = Upgrade Component | disciplines = weaponsmith | rating = 400 | ingredient1 = 10 Pile of Lucent Crystal | ingredient2 = 1 Crystal Lodestone | ingredient3 = 10 Glob of Ectoplasm | ingredient4 = 2 Symbol of Enhancement | id = 6075 }} ;Historical recipe {{recipe | source = discovery | type = Upgrade Component | disciplines = weaponsmith | rating = 400 | ingredient1 = 1 Orichalcum Ingot | ingredient2 = 1 Glob of Ectoplasm | ingredient3 = 1 Crystal Lodestone | id = 6075 | status = historical }} === Other === {{Mystic forge sigils text}} == Used in == {{recipe list}} == Notes == * This sigil replaced the [[Superior Sigil of Sanctuary]] with the [[Game updates/2014-04-15|April 15, 2014 game update]]. * This sigil provides a stronger benefit than [[Superior Sigil of Life]], however Superior Sigil of Benevolence only affects healing towards ''other'' allies. * This sigil does not provide a bonus to barrier output, while Superior Sigil of Life does. {{rune and sigil nav}} [[de:Überlegenes Sigill des Wohlwollens]] [[es:Sello superior de benevolencia]] [[fr:Cachet supérieur de bienveillance]]
title: Superior Sigil of Benevolence
